newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares tread water in technical session.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares tread water in technical session.

text.p: Italian shares trod water throughout a limp, technical session on Monday, ending off their lows after a late boost from Wall Street.
"New York probably acted as a parachute but volume is still very thin," said one trader.
The Mibtel all-share index closed off 0.4 percent at 9,802 and the Mib-30 index of blue-chips finished 0.34 percent easier at 14,758.

Car-maker Fiat fell to nearly three-year lows, closing 1.47 percent off at 3,965 lire after hitting 3,920 but some players felt fears of continued falls were overdone and expected support to emerge before it hit 1992 levels of about 3,500 lire.

Traders noted scant liquidity and said investors may be "saving money for the Eni tranche". The size of the retail discount in the second-tranche placement of Eni shares is due to be announced on October 20 and the price set on October 26.
Eni shares bucked the trend to finish 0.29 percent up at 7,360.
Gemina finished 1.12 percent up at 703.3, against the backdrop of an analysts' meeting underway in Milan.
Dealers said Olivetti and Cofide were still attractive targets for speculators. "Olivetti is possibly building up support around the 500 lire mark," said one trader.
Olivetti closed down 3.29 percent at 490.9 while Cofide slid 6.39 percent to 536.3.
Mediobanca ended 1.69 percent down at 8,158 after the release of 1995-96 results.
